# Investigating Room 19 Hotspot and Animations (2026-02-04 09:16Z)

_**User (2026-02-04 10:08Z)**_

In room 19, when trying to OPEN hotspot 400, by default the character wont be opening it, until somethin else in the game happens. There is probably a flag that indicates whether the door can be opened or not. I need you to find in the decompiled code in ghidra what sets that variable to true.

Aside from setting that flag, the game seems to be adding a few stickers to the room. 

I also want you to look into how the game triggers the talking animations from Alfred.2. I observe aside from the fields we have identified, there are a few other bytes with information that i have not identified the use for. I want you to look into that as well. This is an imhex pattern of the structure for talking animations in Aflred.2 as I have identified them:


struct SingleAnim {
    u8 offsetX;
    u8 offsetY;
    u8 w;
    u8 h;
    padding[2];
    u8 numFrames;
};


struct RoomAnimations {
    u32 pointer;
    u8 unknown1[3];
    SingleAnim animA;
    u8 unknown2[5];
    SingleAnim animB;
    u8 unknown3[29];
    RleChunk data @ pointer;
};

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\nimport struct\n\nwith open('files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb') as f:\n    data = f.read()\n\n# Search for 400 (0x190) in dispatch table format\n# Tables start at various offsets in the data segment\n\nprint(\"Searching for hotspot 400 in dispatch tables...\")\n\n# Known table file offsets from ACTION_DISPATCH_TABLES.md\n# These are virtual addresses, need to convert to file offsets\n# Typical DOS EXE: file_offset = virtual_addr - 0x10000 (for segment base) + header offset\n\n# Let's search the entire data segment area\nfor base_offset in [0x4AFF0, 0x4B058, 0x4B124, 0x4B6EA]:\n    if base_offset + 200 &gt; len(data):\n        continue\n    print(f\"\\n=== Checking table at file offset {hex(base_offset)} ===\")\n    offset = 0\n    count = 0\n    while offset &lt; 1000:\n        pos = base_offset + offset\n        if pos + 6 &gt; len(data):\n            break\n        extra_id = struct.unpack('&lt;H', data[pos:pos+2])[0]\n        if extra_id == 0xFFFF:\n            print(f\"  End marker at offset +{offset} ({count} entries)\")\n            break\n        if 380 &lt;= extra_id &lt;= 420:  # Looking around hotspot 400\n            func_ptr = struct.unpack('&lt;I', data[pos+2:pos+6])[0]\n            print(f\"  Found extra_id {extra_id} at offset +{offset}, func={hex(func_ptr)}\")\n        count += 1\n        offset += 6\n\n# Also search the raw bytes for 0x190 0x01 pattern followed by function pointer\nprint(\"\\n\\n=== Raw search for 0x90 0x01 (400 LE) in code ===\")\ntarget = bytes([0x90, 0x01])\npos = 0\ncount = 0\nwhile True:\n    pos = data.find(target, pos)\n    if pos == -1:\n        break\n    # Check context - if it's in code, might have CMP instruction before\n    context_before = data[max(0,pos-3):pos]\n    context_after = data[pos+2:pos+6]\n    if count &lt; 20:  # First 20 occurrences\n        print(f\"  0x{pos:05x}: before={context_before.hex()} after={context_after.hex()}\")\n    count += 1\n    pos += 1\nprint(f\"  Total: {count} occurrences\")\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}
```

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Search for references to room 19 (0x13) and flag operations\"\"\"\nimport struct\n\ndata = open('files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb').read()\n\nout = open('room19_search.txt', 'w')\n\n# Room 19 = 0x13\n# Look for: CMP reg, 0x13 patterns (common x86)\n# 3C 13 = CMP AL, 0x13  \n# 80 FA 13 = CMP DL, 0x13\n# 80 F9 13 = CMP CL, 0x13\n# 83 F8 13 = CMP EAX, 0x13\n# etc.\n\npatterns = [\n    (b'\\x3c\\x13', 'CMP AL, 0x13'),\n    (b'\\x80\\xfa\\x13', 'CMP DL, 0x13'),\n    (b'\\x80\\xf9\\x13', 'CMP CL, 0x13'),\n    (b'\\x83\\xf8\\x13', 'CMP EAX, 0x13'),\n    (b'\\x83\\xfb\\x13', 'CMP EBX, 0x13'),\n    (b'\\x66\\x83\\xf8\\x13', 'CMP AX, 0x13'),\n    (b'\\x3d\\x13\\x00\\x00\\x00', 'CMP EAX, 0x13'),\n    (b'\\x66\\x3d\\x13\\x00', 'CMP AX, 0x13'),\n]\n\nfor pattern, desc in patterns:\n    pos = 0\n    count = 0\n    while True:\n        pos = data.find(pattern, pos)\n        if pos == -1:\n            break\n        context = data[pos:pos+10].hex()\n        # Convert file offset to approximate Ghidra address (base 0x10000)\n        addr = pos + 0x10000\n        if count &lt; 10:\n            out.write(\"0x%05x (Ghidra: 0x%05x): %s - %s\\n\" % (pos, addr, desc, context))\n        count += 1\n        pos += 1\n    out.write(\"  -&gt; Total %d occurrences of %s\\n\\n\" % (count, desc))\n\n# Also search for immediate comparison with 0x19 (room 25 is actually labeled room 19 in 0-indexed?)\n# Actually room 19 in 1-indexed = 0x13\n# But also check 0x19 in case they use different indexing\nout.write(\"\\n=== Also checking 0x19 (decimal 25) ===\\n\")\nfor val in [0x19]:\n    patterns2 = [\n        (bytes([0x3c, val]), 'CMP AL, 0x%02x' % val),\n        (bytes([0x80, 0xfa, val]), 'CMP DL, 0x%02x' % val),\n        (bytes([0x83, 0xf8, val]), 'CMP EAX, 0x%02x' % val),\n    ]\n    for pattern, desc in patterns2:\n        pos = 0\n        count = 0\n        while True:\n            pos = data.find(pattern, pos)\n            if pos == -1:\n                break\n            context = data[pos:pos+10].hex()\n            addr = pos + 0x10000\n            if count &lt; 10:\n                out.write(\"0x%05x (Ghidra: 0x%05x): %s - %s\\n\" % (pos, addr, desc, context))\n            count += 1\n            pos += 1\n        out.write(\"  -&gt; Total %d occurrences of %s\\n\\n\" % (count, desc))\n\nout.close()\nprint(\"Done. Check room19_search.txt\")\n",

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Search for F8 action table entries that might relate to room 19\"\"\"\nimport struct\n\ndata = open('files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb').read()\n\nout = open('f8_table_search.txt', 'w')\n\n# F8 action table at virtual address 0x47e58\n# Need to find file offset: assume base = 0x10000, but the actual table will be in data segment\n# Let's scan the file for the table pattern\n\n# From the code, the table has format: [uint16 action_id][uint32 function_ptr]\n# Terminated by 0xFFFF\n\n# Search entire file for potential F8 table location\n# Look for sequences of uint16 + uint32 that look like action IDs and function pointers\n\n# Based on segment layout, try finding table at different potential offsets\n# The document mentions file offset 0x4AFF0 for one table\n# Let's check area around there for the F8 table\n\n# According to SAVE_GAME_SYSTEM_ANALYSIS.md, F8 table is at 0x47e58\n# File offset would be around 0x47e58 - some_base\n\n# Let's try to find it by searching for known patterns\n# Room 19 sticker actions might have IDs in range 1900-1999 or similar\n\nout.write(\"Searching for potential F8 action table entries...\\n\\n\")\n\n# Search for the sticker enable table (0x49680 according to load_stickers_from_alfred6)\n# Format: [enable_flag:1][offset:4][size:2] = 7 bytes per sticker\n# Room 19 (0x13) starts at offset 0x13 * 0x8c = 0x0B14 = 2836 bytes into table\n\nsticker_table_offset_candidates = []\nfor offset in range(0x40000, 0x55000, 7):  # Search data segment area\n    # Look for patterns that could be sticker entries\n    if offset + 7 &gt; len(data):\n        break\n    enable = data[offset]\n    if enable in [0, 1]:  # Valid enable flag\n        file_offset = struct.unpack('&lt;I', data[offset+1:offset+5])[0]\n        size = struct.unpack('&lt;H', data[offset+5:offset+7])[0]\n        # Check if offset and size are reasonable\n        if 0 &lt; file_offset &lt; 2000000 and 0 &lt; size &lt; 50000:\n            sticker_table_offset_candidates.append((offset, enable, file_offset, size))\n\nout.write(\"Potential sticker table entries (first 20):\\n\")\nfor entry in sticker_table_offset_candidates[:20]:\n    out.write(\"  File offset 0x%05x: enable=%d, data_offset=0x%08x, size=%d\\n\" % entry)\n\n# Now search for room 19 specifically\n# Room 19 = 0x13, each room has 0x8c (140) bytes of sticker data (20 stickers * 7 bytes)\n# Table starts at virtual 0x49680\n\n# Let's search for F8 action IDs that might relate to room 19\n# The pattern \"F8 XX YY\" in text triggers action with ID (YY &lt;&lt; 8) | XX\n# Looking for action IDs that enable stickers for room 19\n\nout.write(\"\\n\\nSearching for F8 byte sequence patterns related to room 19...\\n\")\n# F8 control code = 0xF8\npos = 0\nf8_codes = []\nwhile True:\n    pos = data.find(b'\\xf8', pos)\n    if pos == -1:\n        break\n    if pos + 3 &lt; len(data):\n        action_id = struct.unpack('&lt;H', data[pos+1:pos+3])[0]\n        if action_id &lt; 1000:  # Reasonable action ID range\n            f8_codes.append((pos, action_id))\n    pos += 1\n\nout.write(\"F8 control codes found (first 50 with IDs &lt; 1000):\\n\")\nfor pos, action_id in f8_codes[:50]:\n    out.write(\"  0x%05x: F8 action ID = %d (0x%04x)\\n\" % (pos, action_id, action_id))\n\nout.close()\nprint(\"Done. Check f8_table_search.txt\")\n",

  "commandLine": {
    "original": "cd /Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools &amp;&amp; python3 -c \"\nimport struct\n\nwith open('files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb') as f:\n    data = f.read()\n\n# For LE (Linear Executable) DOS/4GW, the image base is typically in the header\n# But we can also search for known table patterns\n# The table entries are 6 bytes: 2-byte ID, 4-byte function pointer\n\n# Let's search for the terminator 0xFFFF followed by reasonable patterns\n# Or look for entries with function pointers in reasonable code range (0x10000-0x40000)\n\n# Let's try different offsets by looking for FFFF terminators with preceding data\nresults = []\nfor offset in range(0x40000, 0x55000):\n    if data[offset:offset+2] == b'\\xff\\xff':\n        # Check if preceding 6 bytes look like a valid entry\n        if offset &gt;= 6:\n            entry_id = struct.unpack('&lt;H', data[offset-6:offset-4])[0]\n            func_ptr = struct.unpack('&lt;I', data[offset-4:offset])[0]\n            # Check if function pointer is in reasonable range\n            if 0x10000 &lt;= func_ptr &lt;= 0x40000 and entry_id &lt; 0x1000:\n                results.append((offset-6, entry_id, func_ptr))\n\nwith open('table_search.txt', 'w') as f:\n    f.write('Potential table terminators found:\\n')\n    for off, eid, fptr in results[:30]:\n        f.write(f'  Last entry at 0x{off:05x}: ID={eid} (0x{eid:04x}), func=0x{fptr:05x}\\n')\n\" &amp;&amp; cat table_search.txt",
    "toolEdited": " cd /Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools &amp;&amp; python3 -c \"\nimport struct\n\nwith open('files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb') as f:\n    data = f.read()\n\n# For LE (Linear Executable) DOS/4GW, the image base is typically in the header\n# But we can also search for known table patterns\n# The table entries are 6 bytes: 2-byte ID, 4-byte function pointer\n\n# Let's search for the terminator 0xFFFF followed by reasonable patterns\n# Or look for entries with function pointers in reasonable code range (0x10000-0x40000)\n\n# Let's try different offsets by looking for FFFF terminators with preceding data\nresults = []\nfor offset in range(0x40000, 0x55000):\n    if data[offset:offset+2] == b'\\xff\\xff':\n        # Check if preceding 6 bytes look like a valid entry\n        if offset &gt;= 6:\n            entry_id = struct.unpack('&lt;H', data[offset-6:offset-4])[0]\n            func_ptr = struct.unpack('&lt;I', data[offset-4:offset])[0]\n            # Check if function pointer is in reasonable range\n            if 0x10000 &lt;= func_ptr &lt;= 0x40000 and entry_id &lt; 0x1000:\n                results.append((offset-6, entry_id, func_ptr))\n\nwith open('table_search.txt', 'w') as f:\n    f.write('Potential table terminators found:\\n')\n    for off, eid, fptr in results[:30]:\n        f.write(f'  Last entry at 0x{off:05x}: ID={eid} (0x{eid:04x}), func=0x{fptr:05x}\\n')\n\" &amp;&amp; cat table_search.txt"

{
  "invocationMessage": "Creating [](file:///Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/extract_tables.py)",
  "pastTenseMessage": "Created [](file:///Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/extract_tables.py)",
  "isConfirmed": {
    "type": 1
  },
  "content": "",
  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\nimport struct\n\nwith open('files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb') as f:\n    data = f.read()\n\n# Known table addresses from Ghidra analysis:\n# 0x47bf0 - LOOK table (6-byte entries)\n# 0x47c10 - PUSH table\n# 0x47c18 - table\n# 0x47cbc - PULL table  \n# 0x47d24 - OPEN table\n# 0x47e58 - F8 action dispatch table\n# 0x48118 - Item combination table (8-byte entries)\n# 0x49680 - Sticker table (7-byte entries)\n\n# These are memory addresses. Need to figure out file offset.\n# For DOS4GW LE format, we need to find where code/data segment is mapped.\n\n# Let's look at the beginning of tables by checking for consecutive valid entries\ndef read_table_from_end(data, term_offset, entry_size=6, max_entries=300):\n    \"\"\"Read backwards from terminator to find table start\"\"\"\n    entries = []\n    pos = term_offset - entry_size\n    while pos &gt;= 0 and len(entries) &lt; max_entries:\n        entry_id = struct.unpack('&lt;H', data[pos:pos+2])[0]\n        func_ptr = struct.unpack('&lt;I', data[pos+2:pos+6])[0]\n        \n        # Valid entry check: ID &lt; 2000, func_ptr in code range\n        if entry_id &gt; 2000 or not (0x10000 &lt;= func_ptr &lt;= 0x45000):\n            break\n        entries.append((pos, entry_id, func_ptr))\n        pos -= entry_size\n    return list(reversed(entries))\n\n# Found terminators from previous search - check 0x4b310\nprint(\"=== Table at terminator 0x4b310 ===\")\nentries = read_table_from_end(data, 0x4b310, entry_size=6)\nprint(f\"Found {len(entries)} entries\")\nfor pos, eid, fptr in entries[:30]:\n    print(f\"  File 0x{pos:05x}: ID {eid:4d} (0x{eid:04x}) -&gt; 0x{fptr:05x}\")\nprint()\n\n# Check 0x4b044\nprint(\"=== Table at terminator 0x4b044 ===\")\nentries = read_table_from_end(data, 0x4b044, entry_size=6)\nprint(f\"Found {len(entries)} entries\")\nfor pos, eid, fptr in entries[:30]:\n    print(f\"  File 0x{pos:05x}: ID {eid:4d} (0x{eid:04x}) -&gt; 0x{fptr:05x}\")\nprint()\n\n# Check 0x4b6d8\nprint(\"=== Table at terminator 0x4b6d8 ===\")  \nentries = read_table_from_end(data, 0x4b6d8, entry_size=6)\nprint(f\"Found {len(entries)} entries\")\nfor pos, eid, fptr in entries[:30]:\n    print(f\"  File 0x{pos:05x}: ID {eid:4d} (0x{eid:04x}) -&gt; 0x{fptr:05x}\")\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}

{
  "invocationMessage": "Creating [](file:///Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/read_dispatch_tables.py)",
  "pastTenseMessage": "Created [](file:///Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/read_dispatch_tables.py)",
  "isConfirmed": {
    "type": 1
  },
  "content": "",
  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\nimport struct\n\nwith open('files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb') as f:\n    data = f.read()\n\n# Memory address 0x47bf0 maps to file offset 0x4aff0 (LOOK table)\n# Memory address 0x47bf0 -&gt; File offset 0x4aff0\n# Difference: 0x4aff0 - 0x47bf0 = 0x3400\n\n# So F8 table at memory 0x47e58 -&gt; File offset 0x47e58 + 0x3400 = 0x4b258\n\nfile_base_offset = 0x3400\n\ntables = {\n    'LOOK (0x47bf0)': 0x47bf0,\n    'PUSH (0x47c10)': 0x47c10,\n    'table_47c18 (0x47c18)': 0x47c18,\n    'PULL (0x47cbc)': 0x47cbc,\n    'OPEN (0x47d24)': 0x47d24,\n    'F8_ACTION (0x47e58)': 0x47e58,\n    'ITEM_COMBO (0x48118)': 0x48118,\n}\n\ndef read_table(data, file_offset, entry_size=6, max_entries=300):\n    \"\"\"Read table from start until 0xFFFF terminator\"\"\"\n    entries = []\n    pos = file_offset\n    while len(entries) &lt; max_entries:\n        entry_id = struct.unpack('&lt;H', data[pos:pos+2])[0]\n        if entry_id == 0xFFFF:\n            break\n        func_ptr = struct.unpack('&lt;I', data[pos+2:pos+6])[0]\n        entries.append((pos, entry_id, func_ptr))\n        pos += entry_size\n    return entries\n\nfor name, mem_addr in tables.items():\n    file_offset = mem_addr + file_base_offset\n    print(f\"=== {name} at file 0x{file_offset:05x} ===\")\n    entries = read_table(data, file_offset)\n    print(f\"Found {len(entries)} entries\")\n    \n    # Show first 20 and last 5\n    for pos, eid, fptr in entries[:20]:\n        print(f\"  File 0x{pos:05x}: ID {eid:4d} (0x{eid:04x}) -&gt; 0x{fptr:05x}\")\n    if len(entries) &gt; 25:\n        print(\"  ...\")\n        for pos, eid, fptr in entries[-5:]:\n            print(f\"  File 0x{pos:05x}: ID {eid:4d} (0x{eid:04x}) -&gt; 0x{fptr:05x}\")\n    print()\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nAnalyze room 19 hotspot data from ALFRED.1 to understand hotspot 400.\n\"\"\"\nimport struct\n\n# Room 19 = index 19\nROOM_INDEX = 19\n\nwith open('files/ALFRED.1', 'rb') as f:\n    data = f.read()\n\n# Room directory at start of file: 56 rooms × 13 data pairs (offset+size)\n# Each pair is 4 bytes offset + 4 bytes size = 8 bytes\n# So room directory is 56 * 13 * 8 = 5824 bytes\n\ndef get_room_pair(room_idx, pair_idx):\n    \"\"\"Get offset and size for a room's data pair\"\"\"\n    entry_offset = (room_idx * 13 + pair_idx) * 8\n    offset = struct.unpack('&lt;I', data[entry_offset:entry_offset+4])[0]\n    size = struct.unpack('&lt;I', data[entry_offset+4:entry_offset+8])[0]\n    return offset, size\n\n# Get pair 10 which contains hotspots/walkboxes/exits\npair10_offset, pair10_size = get_room_pair(ROOM_INDEX, 10)\nprint(f\"Room {ROOM_INDEX} pair 10 (hotspots/walkboxes/exits):\")\nprint(f\"  Offset: 0x{pair10_offset:08x}, Size: {pair10_size}\")\n\n# Read the room data\nroom_data = data[pair10_offset:pair10_offset+pair10_size]\n\n# Hotspot structure at room_data+0x47A: count at +0x47A, entries start at +0x47C\n# Each hotspot is 9 bytes:\n# +0: action_flags (1 byte, high bit)\n# +1: hotspot_index (1 byte)\n# +2-3: x position (2 bytes)\n# +4-5: y position (2 bytes)\n# +6: width (1 byte)\n# +7: height (1 byte)\n# +8-9: extra_id (2 bytes)\n\nif len(room_data) &gt; 0x47B:\n    hotspot_count = room_data[0x47A]\n    print(f\"\\nNumber of hotspots: {hotspot_count}\")\n    print(\"\\nHotspots:\")\n    \n    for i in range(hotspot_count):\n        hotspot_offset = 0x47C + i * 9\n        if hotspot_offset + 9 &gt; len(room_data):\n            print(f\"  Hotspot {i}: Data out of bounds\")\n            continue\n        \n        action_flags = room_data[hotspot_offset]\n        hotspot_idx = room_data[hotspot_offset + 1]\n        x = struct.unpack('&lt;H', room_data[hotspot_offset+2:hotspot_offset+4])[0]\n        y = struct.unpack('&lt;H', room_data[hotspot_offset+4:hotspot_offset+6])[0]\n        w = room_data[hotspot_offset + 6]\n        h = room_data[hotspot_offset + 7]\n        extra_id = struct.unpack('&lt;H', room_data[hotspot_offset+8:hotspot_offset+10])[0]\n        \n        # Parse action flags\n        flags = []\n        if action_flags &amp; 0x01: flags.append('OPEN')\n        if action_flags &amp; 0x02: flags.append('CLOSE')\n        if action_flags &amp; 0x04: flags.append('UNK04')\n        if action_flags &amp; 0x08: flags.append('PICKUP')\n        if action_flags &amp; 0x10: flags.append('TALK')\n        if action_flags &amp; 0x20: flags.append('PUSH')\n        if action_flags &amp; 0x80: flags.append('PULL')\n        \n        print(f\"  Hotspot {i}: extra_id={extra_id} (0x{extra_id:04x}), \"\n              f\"flags=0x{action_flags:02x} [{','.join(flags) or 'NONE'}], \"\n              f\"pos=({x},{y}), size=({w},{h})\")\n        \n        # Highlight hotspot 400\n        if extra_id == 400:\n            print(f\"    *** THIS IS HOTSPOT 400 ***\")\nelse:\n    print(\"Room data too short to contain hotspot info\")\n",

}

  "content": "",
  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nSearch ALFRED.1 for the byte pattern 0x90 0x01 (400 in little-endian)\nand show context to understand where hotspot 400 comes from.\n\"\"\"\nimport struct\n\nwith open('files/ALFRED.1', 'rb') as f:\n    data = f.read()\n\nTARGET = 400\npattern = struct.pack('&lt;H', TARGET)\n\nprint(f\"Searching for 0x{TARGET:04x} ({TARGET}) in ALFRED.1...\")\nprint()\n\n# Get room info for context\ndef get_room_pair(room_idx, pair_idx):\n    entry_offset = (room_idx * 13 + pair_idx) * 8\n    offset = struct.unpack('&lt;I', data[entry_offset:entry_offset+4])[0]\n    size = struct.unpack('&lt;I', data[entry_offset+4:entry_offset+8])[0]\n    return offset, size\n\n# Build room offset map\nroom_ranges = []\nfor room_idx in range(56):\n    for pair_idx in range(13):\n        offset, size = get_room_pair(room_idx, pair_idx)\n        if size &gt; 0:\n            room_ranges.append((offset, offset + size, room_idx, pair_idx))\n\nroom_ranges.sort()\n\ndef find_room_for_offset(offset):\n    for start, end, room_idx, pair_idx in room_ranges:\n        if start &lt;= offset &lt; end:\n            return room_idx, pair_idx, offset - start\n    return None, None, None\n\n# Search for pattern\npos = 0\nfound = []\nwhile True:\n    idx = data.find(pattern, pos)\n    if idx == -1:\n        break\n    room_idx, pair_idx, rel_offset = find_room_for_offset(idx)\n    context = data[max(0, idx-8):idx+16].hex()\n    found.append((idx, room_idx, pair_idx, rel_offset, context))\n    pos = idx + 1\n\nprint(f\"Found {len(found)} occurrences of 0x0190 (400):\")\nprint()\n\n# Group by room\nby_room = {}\nfor idx, room_idx, pair_idx, rel_offset, context in found:\n    if room_idx is not None:\n        key = (room_idx, pair_idx)\n        if key not in by_room:\n            by_room[key] = []\n        by_room[key].append((idx, rel_offset, context))\n\nfor (room_idx, pair_idx), occurrences in sorted(by_room.items()):\n    print(f\"Room {room_idx}, Pair {pair_idx}:\")\n    for idx, rel_offset, context in occurrences[:5]:\n        print(f\"  File 0x{idx:08x}, rel 0x{rel_offset:04x}: {context}\")\n    if len(occurrences) &gt; 5:\n        print(f\"  ... and {len(occurrences) - 5} more\")\n    print()\n\n# Check if not in any room\nnot_in_room = [(idx, context) for idx, room_idx, _, _, context in found if room_idx is None]\nif not_in_room:\n    print(\"Not in any room data:\")\n    for idx, context in not_in_room[:10]:\n        print(f\"  File 0x{idx:08x}: {context}\")\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\nimport struct\n\nwith open('files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb') as f:\n    data = f.read()\n\n# Sticker table memory address range: 0x49680 - 0x4B198\nsticker_start = 0x49680\nsticker_end = 0x4B198\n\nresults = []\n\n# Search for mov byte [addr], imm8 (C6 05)\ni = 0\nwhile i &lt; len(data) - 8:\n    if data[i] == 0xC6 and data[i+1] == 0x05:\n        addr = struct.unpack('&lt;I', data[i+2:i+6])[0]\n        if sticker_start &lt;= addr &lt; sticker_end:\n            value = data[i+6]\n            results.append((i, addr, 'byte', value))\n    i += 1\n\n# Search for mov dword [addr], imm32 (C7 05)\ni = 0\nwhile i &lt; len(data) - 11:\n    if data[i] == 0xC7 and data[i+1] == 0x05:\n        addr = struct.unpack('&lt;I', data[i+2:i+6])[0]\n        if sticker_start &lt;= addr &lt; sticker_end:\n            value = struct.unpack('&lt;I', data[i+6:i+10])[0]\n            results.append((i, addr, 'dword', value))\n    i += 1\n\nprint(f\"Found {len(results)} writes to sticker table (0x{sticker_start:x}-0x{sticker_end:x}):\")\nprint()\n\nfor file_off, mem_addr, size, value in results:\n    # Calculate which room and sticker\n    rel = mem_addr - sticker_start\n    room = rel // 0x8c\n    sticker_offset = rel % 0x8c\n    sticker_idx = sticker_offset // 7\n    field_offset = sticker_offset % 7\n    \n    field_names = ['enable', 'offset0', 'offset1', 'offset2', 'offset3', 'size0', 'size1']\n    field = field_names[field_offset] if field_offset &lt; 7 else f'unk{field_offset}'\n    \n    print(f\"File 0x{file_off:05x}: MOV {size} [0x{mem_addr:05x}], 0x{value:x}\")\n    print(f\"  -&gt; Room {room}, Sticker {sticker_idx}, Field: {field}\")\n    print()\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}
```

sticker_end:\n                reg = reg_names.get(mod_rm, '?')\n                write_patterns.append((i, addr, '89 {:02x}'.format(mod_rm), 'MOV [addr], {}'.format(reg), None))\n\n# Pattern 4: MOV byte [addr], reg (88 05/0D/15/1D/25/2D/35/3D)\nfor mod_rm in [0x05, 0x0D, 0x15, 0x1D, 0x25, 0x2D, 0x35, 0x3D]:\n    reg_names = {0x05: 'AL', 0x0D: 'CL', 0x15: 'DL', 0x1D: 'BL',\n                 0x25: 'AH', 0x2D: 'CH', 0x35: 'DH', 0x3D: 'BH'}\n    for i in range(len(data) - 6):\n        if data[i] == 0x88 and data[i+1] == mod_rm:\n            addr = struct.unpack('&lt;I', data[i+2:i+6])[0]\n            if sticker_start &lt;= addr &lt; sticker_end:\n                reg = reg_names.get(mod_rm, '?')\n                write_patterns.append((i, addr, '88 {:02x}'.format(mod_rm), 'MOV BYTE [addr], {}'.format(reg), None))\n\n# Sort by file offset\nwrite_patterns.sort(key=lambda x: x[0])\n\nprint(\"Found {} potential writes to sticker table:\".format(len(write_patterns)))\nprint()\n\n# Write results to file for reliable capture\nwith open('/Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/sticker_writes_output.txt', 'w') as out:\n    out.write(\"=== STICKER TABLE WRITES ===\\n\")\n    out.write(\"Sticker table range: 0x{:x} - 0x{:x}\\n\\n\".format(sticker_start, sticker_end))\n    out.write(\"Found {} writes:\\n\\n\".format(len(write_patterns)))\n    \n    for file_off, mem_addr, pattern, desc, value in write_patterns:\n        rel = mem_addr - sticker_start\n        room = rel // 0x8c\n        sticker_offset = rel % 0x8c\n        sticker_idx = sticker_offset // 7\n        field_offset = sticker_offset % 7\n        \n        field_names = ['enable', 'offset0', 'offset1', 'offset2', 'offset3', 'size0', 'size1']\n        field = field_names[field_offset] if field_offset &lt; len(data) - 4:\n        if data[i:i+4] == base_bytes:\n            ctx_start = max(0, i - 4)\n            ctx_end = min(len(data), i + 8)\n            ctx = data[ctx_start:ctx_end]\n            if (i, ctx.hex(), ctx) not in base_refs:\n                base_refs.append((i, ctx.hex(), ctx))\n        i += 1\n\nbase_refs.sort(key=lambda x: x[0])\n\nprint(\"Found {} references to sticker table base addresses:\".format(len(base_refs)))\nprint()\n\n# Write results to file for reliable capture\nwith open('/Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/sticker_writes_output.txt', 'w') as out:\n    out.write(\"=== STICKER TABLE REFERENCES (base 0x49680) ===\\n\\n\")\n    out.write(\"Found {} references:\\n\\n\".format(len(base_refs)))\n    \n    for file_off, ctx_hex, ctx_bytes in base_refs:\n        # Analyze instruction pattern\n        # Look at byte before the address to understand the instruction\n        prefix_idx = file_off - max(0, file_off - 4)\n        \n        line = \"File offset 0x{:05x}: context = {}\".format(file_off, ctx_hex)\n        print(line)\n        out.write(line + \"\\n\")\n        \n        # Try to identify if this is a read or write\n        if file_off &gt;= 2:\n            opcode_bytes = data[file_off-2:file_off]\n            if opcode_bytes[1] in [0x88, 0x89]:  # MOV [reg+disp32], reg\n                line = \"  -&gt; WRITE instruction (MOV [reg+disp32], reg)\"\n                print(line)\n                out.write(line + \"\\n\")\n            elif opcode_bytes[1] in [0x8A, 0x8B]:  # MOV reg, [reg+disp32]\n                line = \"  -&gt; READ instruction (MOV reg, [reg+disp32])\"\n                print(line)\n                out.write(line + \"\\n\")\n            elif opcode_bytes[1] == 0xC6:  # MOV byte [disp32], imm8\n                line = \"  -&gt; WRITE instruction (MOV BYTE PTR)\"\n                print(line)\n                out.write(line + \"\\n\")\n        print()\n        out.write(\"\\n\")\n\n# Now let's search for writes to individual sticker entries (direct MOV with full address)\nprint(\"\\n=== SEARCHING FOR DIRECT WRITES TO SPECIFIC STICKER ENTRIES ===\\n\")\n\n# Search for MOV byte ptr [addr], imm8 where addr is in sticker range\n# Pattern: C6 05 [addr32] [imm8]\n# Also: C6 80-BF [addr32] [imm8] for other ModRM patterns\ndirect_writes = []\n\nfor i in range(len(data) - 8):\n    if data[i] == 0xC6 and data[i+1] == 0x05:  # MOV BYTE PTR [disp32], imm8\n        addr = struct.unpack('&lt;I', data[i+2:i+6])[0]\n        if sticker_start &lt;= addr &lt; sticker_end:\n            value = data[i+6]\n            direct_writes.append((i, addr, 'BYTE', value))\n    if data[i] == 0xC7 and data[i+1] == 0x05:  # MOV DWORD PTR [disp32], imm32\n        addr = struct.unpack('&lt;I', data[i+2:i+6])[0]\n        if sticker_start &lt;= addr &lt; sticker_end:\n            value = struct.unpack('&lt;I', data[i+6:i+10])[0]\n            direct_writes.append((i, addr, 'DWORD', value))\n\nprint(\"Found {} direct MOV writes to sticker table entries:\".format(len(direct_writes)))\nfor file_off, addr, size, value in direct_writes:\n    rel = addr - sticker_start\n    room = rel // 0x8c\n    sticker_offset = rel % 0x8c\n    sticker_idx = sticker_offset // 7\n    field_offset = sticker_offset % 7\n    field_names = ['enable', 'offset0', 'offset1', 'offset2', 'offset3', 'size0', 'size1']\n    field = field_names[field_offset] if field_offset &lt; 7 else \"unk\"\n    \n    print(\"  File 0x{:05x}: MOV {} [0x{:05x}], 0x{:x} -&gt; Room {}, Sticker {}, {}\".format(\n        file_off, size, addr, value, room, sticker_idx, field))\n",

{
  "invocationMessage": "Creating [](file:///Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/extract_f8_dispatch.py)",
  "pastTenseMessage": "Created [](file:///Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/extract_f8_dispatch.py)",
  "isConfirmed": {
    "type": 1
  },
  "content": "",
  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nExtract and analyze the F8 dispatch table from JUEGO.EXE\n\nMemory address: 0x47e58\nFile offset: memory + 0x3400 = 0x4B258\nFormat: 6-byte entries (2-byte action ID, 4-byte function pointer)\nTable ends when action ID == -1 (0xFFFF)\n\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\nimport os\n\nEXE_PATH = \"/Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/files/JUEGO.EXE\"\nMEMORY_BASE = 0x47e58\nFILE_OFFSET_ADJUSTMENT = 0x3400\nFILE_OFFSET = MEMORY_BASE + FILE_OFFSET_ADJUSTMENT\n\nENTRY_SIZE = 6  # 2 bytes action ID + 4 bytes function pointer\n\ndef extract_f8_dispatch_table():\n    \"\"\"Extract all entries from the F8 dispatch table.\"\"\"\n    \n    if not os.path.exists(EXE_PATH):\n        print(f\"ERROR: File not found: {EXE_PATH}\")\n        return []\n    \n    entries = []\n    \n    with open(EXE_PATH, \"rb\") as f:\n        file_size = f.seek(0, 2)\n        f.seek(0)\n        \n        print(f\"File size: {file_size} bytes (0x{file_size:X})\")\n        print(f\"Memory address: 0x{MEMORY_BASE:X}\")\n        print(f\"File offset: 0x{FILE_OFFSET:X}\")\n        print()\n        \n        if FILE_OFFSET &gt;= file_size:\n            print(f\"ERROR: File offset 0x{FILE_OFFSET:X} is beyond file size 0x{file_size:X}\")\n            return []\n        \n        f.seek(FILE_OFFSET)\n        \n        entry_num = 0\n        while True:\n            data = f.read(ENTRY_SIZE)\n            if len(data) &lt; ENTRY_SIZE:\n                print(f\"Reached end of file at entry {entry_num}\")\n                break\n            \n            action_id, func_ptr = struct.unpack(\"&lt;Hxxxx\", data[:2] + b'\\x00\\x00\\x00\\x00')\n            action_id, func_ptr = struct.unpack(\"&lt;HI\", data)\n            \n            # Check for end marker\n            if action_id == 0xFFFF:\n                print(f\"Found end marker (0xFFFF) at entry {entry_num}\")\n                break\n            \n            entries.append({\n                'entry_num': entry_num,\n                'action_id': action_id,\n                'func_ptr': func_ptr,\n                'file_offset': FILE_OFFSET + entry_num * ENTRY_SIZE\n            })\n            \n            entry_num += 1\n            \n            # Safety limit\n            if entry_num &gt; 1000:\n                print(\"WARNING: Exceeded 1000 entries, stopping\")\n                break\n    \n    return entries\n\ndef print_entries(entries):\n    \"\"\"Print all entries in a readable format.\"\"\"\n    \n    print(\"=\" * 70)\n    print(\"F8 DISPATCH TABLE ENTRIES\")\n    print(\"=\" * 70)\n    print(f\"{'#':&lt;5} {'Action ID':&lt;12} {'Hex':&lt;8} {'Function Ptr':&lt;14} {'File Offset'}\")\n    print(\"-\" * 70)\n    \n    for e in entries:\n        print(f\"{e['entry_num']:&lt;5} {e['action_id']:&lt;12} 0x{e['action_id']:04X}    0x{e['func_ptr']:08X}    0x{e['file_offset']:X}\")\n    \n    print(\"-\" * 70)\n    print(f\"Total entries: {len(entries)}\")\n    print()\n\ndef search_near_action_id(entries, target, range_val=20):\n    \"\"\"Search for entries with action IDs near a target value.\"\"\"\n    \n    print(\"=\" * 70)\n    print(f\"ENTRIES NEAR ACTION ID {target} (0x{target:X}) +/- {range_val}\")\n    print(\"=\" * 70)\n    \n    found = []\n    for e in entries:\n        if abs(e['action_id'] - target) &lt;= range_val:\n            found.append(e)\n    \n    if found:\n        print(f\"{'#':&lt;5} {'Action ID':&lt;12} {'Hex':&lt;8} {'Function Ptr':&lt;14} {'Diff from {}'.format(target)}\")\n        print(\"-\" * 70)\n        for e in found:\n            diff = e['action_id'] - target\n            diff_str = f\"+{diff}\" if diff &gt;= 0 else str(diff)\n            print(f\"{e['entry_num']:&lt;5} {e['action_id']:&lt;12} 0x{e['action_id']:04X}    0x{e['func_ptr']:08X}    {diff_str}\")\n    else:\n        print(f\"No entries found near {target}\")\n    \n    print()\n    return found\n\ndef analyze_by_ranges(entries):\n    \"\"\"Analyze entries grouped by action ID ranges (possible room correlation).\"\"\"\n    \n    print(\"=\" * 70)\n    print(\"ANALYSIS BY ACTION ID RANGES (Possible Room Correlation)\")\n    print(\"=\" * 70)\n    \n    # Group by hundreds\n    ranges = {}\n    for e in entries:\n        range_start = (e['action_id'] // 100) * 100\n        if range_start not in ranges:\n            ranges[range_start] = []\n        ranges[range_start].append(e)\n    \n    for range_start in sorted(ranges.keys()):\n        range_entries = ranges[range_start]\n        print(f\"\\nRange {range_start}-{range_start+99} (0x{range_start:X}-0x{range_start+99:X}): {len(range_entries)} entries\")\n        for e in range_entries:\n            print(f\"    Action {e['action_id']:4} (0x{e['action_id']:04X}) -&gt; 0x{e['func_ptr']:08X}\")\n    \n    print()\n\ndef find_exact_action(entries, action_id):\n    \"\"\"Find exact action ID match.\"\"\"\n    \n    for e in entries:\n        if e['action_id'] == action_id:\n            return e\n    return None\n\ndef main():\n    print(\"=\" * 70)\n    print(\"F8 DISPATCH TABLE EXTRACTION FROM JUEGO.EXE\")\n    print(\"=\" * 70)\n    print()\n    \n    entries = extract_f8_dispatch_table()\n    \n    if not entries:\n        print(\"No entries found!\")\n        return\n    \n    print_entries(entries)\n    \n    # Search for entries near 400 (0x190) - the hotspot we're investigating\n    search_near_action_id(entries, 400, range_val=50)\n    \n    # Also check specific action IDs that might relate to room 19\n    # Room 19 might use action IDs in range 1900-1999 or 190-199\n    print(\"=\" * 70)\n    print(\"CHECKING SPECIFIC ACTION IDS FOR ROOM 19\")\n    print(\"=\" * 70)\n    \n    specific_ids = [19, 190, 191, 192, 400, 1900, 1901, 1902]\n    for aid in specific_ids:\n        result = find_exact_action(entries, aid)\n        if result:\n            print(f\"Action ID {aid} (0x{aid:04X}) found: func_ptr = 0x{result['func_ptr']:08X}\")\n        else:\n            print(f\"Action ID {aid} (0x{aid:04X}) NOT found in table\")\n    \n    print()\n    \n    # Group analysis\n    analyze_by_ranges(entries)\n    \n    # Summary statistics\n    print(\"=\" * 70)\n    print(\"SUMMARY STATISTICS\")\n    print(\"=\" * 70)\n    if entries:\n        action_ids = [e['action_id'] for e in entries]\n        print(f\"Total entries: {len(entries)}\")\n        print(f\"Min action ID: {min(action_ids)} (0x{min(action_ids):04X})\")\n        print(f\"Max action ID: {max(action_ids)} (0x{max(action_ids):04X})\")\n        \n        func_ptrs = set(e['func_ptr'] for e in entries)\n        print(f\"Unique function pointers: {len(func_ptrs)}\")\n        \n        # Show most common function pointers\n        ptr_counts = {}\n        for e in entries:\n            ptr = e['func_ptr']\n            ptr_counts[ptr] = ptr_counts.get(ptr, 0) + 1\n        \n        print(\"\\nMost common function pointers:\")\n        for ptr, count in sorted(ptr_counts.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1])[:10]:\n            print(f\"  0x{ptr:08X}: {count} entries\")\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Simple F8 table dumper\"\"\"\nimport struct\n\nEXE = \"/Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/files/JUEGO.EXE\"\nOFFSET = 0x47e58 + 0x3400  # memory to file\n\nwith open(EXE, \"rb\") as f:\n    f.seek(OFFSET)\n    i = 0\n    print(\"# ActionID FuncPtr\")\n    while i &lt; 300:\n        d = f.read(6)\n        if len(d) &lt; 6:\n            break\n        aid, fptr = struct.unpack(\"&lt;HI\", d)\n        if aid == 0xFFFF:\n            print(f\"END at entry {i}\")\n            break\n        print(f\"{i:3d} 0x{aid:04X} ({aid:5d}) -&gt; 0x{fptr:08X}\")\n        i += 1\n",

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Simple F8 table dumper - reads from known offset\"\"\"\nimport struct\n\nEXE = \"/Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/files/JUEGO.EXE\"\n# F8 dispatch table offset in file\n# Memory 0x47e58, file offset = memory - 0x3400 for DOS EXE\nFILE_OFFSET = 0x47e58 - 0x3400  \n\nprint(f\"Reading F8 table from file offset 0x{FILE_OFFSET:X}\")\nprint(\"=\" * 60)\n\nwith open(EXE, \"rb\") as f:\n    f.seek(FILE_OFFSET)\n    entries = []\n    i = 0\n    print(f\"{'#':&gt;3} {'ActionID':&gt;10} {'Dec':&gt;6} -&gt; {'FuncPtr':&gt;12}\")\n    print(\"-\" * 60)\n    \n    while i &lt; 500:  # Read up to 500 entries\n        d = f.read(6)\n        if len(d) &lt; 6:\n            print(f\"EOF at entry {i}\")\n            break\n        aid, fptr = struct.unpack(\"&lt;HI\", d)\n        \n        # Check for terminator\n        if aid == 0xFFFF:\n            print(f\"END marker (0xFFFF) at entry {i}\")\n            break\n        \n        entries.append((aid, fptr))\n        print(f\"{i:3d}   0x{aid:04X}  {aid:5d} -&gt; 0x{fptr:08X}\")\n        i += 1\n\nprint(\"=\" * 60)\nprint(f\"Total entries: {len(entries)}\")\n\n# Analyze function pointer frequency\nprint(\"\\n\" + \"=\" * 60)\nprint(\"Function Pointer Frequency Analysis:\")\nprint(\"-\" * 60)\nfunc_count = {}\nfor aid, fptr in entries:\n    func_count[fptr] = func_count.get(fptr, 0) + 1\n\n# Sort by count descending\nsorted_funcs = sorted(func_count.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1])\nfor fptr, count in sorted_funcs[:20]:  # Top 20\n    print(f\"  0x{fptr:08X}: {count} times\")\n\n# Look for entries near action ID 400 (0x190)\nprint(\"\\n\" + \"=\" * 60)\nprint(\"Entries near Action ID 400 (0x190):\")\nprint(\"-\" * 60)\nfor idx, (aid, fptr) in enumerate(entries):\n    if 390 &lt;= aid &lt;= 410:\n        print(f\"  Entry {idx}: ActionID=0x{aid:04X} ({aid}) -&gt; 0x{fptr:08X}\")\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Simple F8 table dumper - reads from known offset, outputs to file\"\"\"\nimport struct\n\nEXE = \"/Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/files/JUEGO.EXE\"\nOUTPUT = \"/Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/f8_table_output.txt\"\n\n# F8 dispatch table offset in file\n# Memory 0x47e58, file offset = memory - 0x3400 for DOS EXE\nFILE_OFFSET = 0x47e58 - 0x3400  \n\nlines = []\nlines.append(f\"Reading F8 table from file offset 0x{FILE_OFFSET:X}\")\nlines.append(\"=\" * 60)\n\nwith open(EXE, \"rb\") as f:\n    f.seek(FILE_OFFSET)\n    entries = []\n    i = 0\n    lines.append(f\"{'#':&gt;3} {'ActionID':&gt;10} {'Dec':&gt;6} -&gt; {'FuncPtr':&gt;12}\")\n    lines.append(\"-\" * 60)\n    \n    while i &lt; 500:  # Read up to 500 entries\n        d = f.read(6)\n        if len(d) &lt; 6:\n            lines.append(f\"EOF at entry {i}\")\n            break\n        aid, fptr = struct.unpack(\"&lt;HI\", d)\n        \n        # Check for terminator\n        if aid == 0xFFFF:\n            lines.append(f\"END marker (0xFFFF) at entry {i}\")\n            break\n        \n        entries.append((aid, fptr))\n        lines.append(f\"{i:3d}   0x{aid:04X}  {aid:5d} -&gt; 0x{fptr:08X}\")\n        i += 1\n\nlines.append(\"=\" * 60)\nlines.append(f\"Total entries: {len(entries)}\")\n\n# Analyze function pointer frequency\nlines.append(\"\")\nlines.append(\"=\" * 60)\nlines.append(\"Function Pointer Frequency Analysis:\")\nlines.append(\"-\" * 60)\nfunc_count = {}\nfor aid, fptr in entries:\n    func_count[fptr] = func_count.get(fptr, 0) + 1\n\n# Sort by count descending\nsorted_funcs = sorted(func_count.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1])\nfor fptr, count in sorted_funcs[:20]:  # Top 20\n    lines.append(f\"  0x{fptr:08X}: {count} times\")\n\n# Look for entries near action ID 400 (0x190)\nlines.append(\"\")\nlines.append(\"=\" * 60)\nlines.append(\"Entries near Action ID 400 (0x190):\")\nlines.append(\"-\" * 60)\nfor idx, (aid, fptr) in enumerate(entries):\n    if 390 &lt;= aid &lt;= 410:\n        lines.append(f\"  Entry {idx}: ActionID=0x{aid:04X} ({aid}) -&gt; 0x{fptr:08X}\")\n\n# Write to file\nwith open(OUTPUT, \"w\") as f:\n    f.write(\"\\n\".join(lines))\n\nprint(\"Done - output written to\", OUTPUT)\n",

{
  "invocationMessage": "Creating [](file:///Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/dump_f8_final.py)",
  "pastTenseMessage": "Created [](file:///Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/dump_f8_final.py)",
  "isConfirmed": {

  "content": "",
  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Dump F8 dispatch table properly and save output to file\"\"\"\nimport struct\n\nEXE_PATH = \"/Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/files/JUEGO.EXE\"\nOUTPUT_PATH = \"/Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/f8_dispatch_dump.txt\"\n\n# F8 table: Memory address 0x47e58 -&gt; File offset 0x47e58 + 0x3400 = 0x4b258\nF8_MEM_ADDR = 0x47e58\nFILE_BASE_OFFSET = 0x3400\nF8_FILE_OFFSET = F8_MEM_ADDR + FILE_BASE_OFFSET\n\nwith open(EXE_PATH, 'rb') as f:\n    data = f.read()\n\nlines = []\nlines.append(\"=\" * 70)\nlines.append(\"F8 DISPATCH TABLE DUMP\")\nlines.append(\"=\" * 70)\nlines.append(f\"Memory address: 0x{F8_MEM_ADDR:X}\")\nlines.append(f\"File offset: 0x{F8_FILE_OFFSET:X}\")\nlines.append(\"\")\nlines.append(f\"{'#':&gt;4} {'ID':&gt;6} {'Hex':&gt;8} {'FuncPtr':&gt;14} {'FileOff':&gt;10}\")\nlines.append(\"-\" * 70)\n\nentries = []\npos = F8_FILE_OFFSET\nentry_num = 0\n\nwhile entry_num &lt; 500:\n    entry_id = struct.unpack('&lt;H', data[pos:pos+2])[0]\n    if entry_id == 0xFFFF:\n        lines.append(f\"END marker (0xFFFF) at entry {entry_num}, file offset 0x{pos:X}\")\n        break\n    func_ptr = struct.unpack('&lt;I', data[pos+2:pos+6])[0]\n    entries.append((entry_num, entry_id, func_ptr, pos))\n    lines.append(f\"{entry_num:4d} {entry_id:6d} 0x{entry_id:04X}  0x{func_ptr:08X}  0x{pos:05X}\")\n    pos += 6\n    entry_num += 1\n\nlines.append(\"-\" * 70)\nlines.append(f\"Total entries: {len(entries)}\")\nlines.append(\"\")\n\n# Function pointer frequency analysis\nlines.append(\"=\" * 70)\nlines.append(\"FUNCTION POINTER FREQUENCY (Top 20)\")\nlines.append(\"-\" * 70)\nfunc_count = {}\nfor _, _, fptr, _ in entries:\n    func_count[fptr] = func_count.get(fptr, 0) + 1\n\nfor fptr, count in sorted(func_count.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1])[:20]:\n    lines.append(f\"  0x{fptr:08X}: {count} occurrences\")\n\n# Look for entries near action ID 400 (0x190)\nlines.append(\"\")\nlines.append(\"=\" * 70)\nlines.append(\"ENTRIES NEAR ACTION ID 400 (0x190) +/- 50\")\nlines.append(\"-\" * 70)\nfound_near_400 = []\nfor entry_num, entry_id, fptr, pos in entries:\n    if 350 &lt;= entry_id &lt;= 450:\n        found_near_400.append((entry_num, entry_id, fptr, pos))\n        lines.append(f\"  Entry {entry_num:3d}: ID={entry_id:4d} (0x{entry_id:04X}) -&gt; 0x{fptr:08X}\")\n\nif not found_near_400:\n    lines.append(\"  No entries found in range 350-450\")\n\n# Check for exact 400\nlines.append(\"\")\nlines.append(\"=\" * 70)\nlines.append(\"EXACT ACTION ID 400 (0x190) SEARCH\")\nlines.append(\"-\" * 70)\nfound_400 = [e for e in entries if e[1] == 400]\nif found_400:\n    for entry_num, entry_id, fptr, pos in found_400:\n        lines.append(f\"  FOUND: Entry {entry_num}: ID=400 -&gt; 0x{fptr:08X}\")\nelse:\n    lines.append(\"  Action ID 400 NOT FOUND in F8 table\")\n\n# Group by ID ranges (possible room correlation)\nlines.append(\"\")\nlines.append(\"=\" * 70)\nlines.append(\"ACTION ID RANGES (grouped by hundreds)\")\nlines.append(\"-\" * 70)\nranges = {}\nfor entry_num, entry_id, fptr, pos in entries:\n    range_start = (entry_id // 100) * 100\n    if range_start not in ranges:\n        ranges[range_start] = []\n    ranges[range_start].append((entry_id, fptr))\n\nfor range_start in sorted(ranges.keys())[:30]:  # First 30 ranges\n    lines.append(f\"\\nRange {range_start}-{range_start+99}: {len(ranges[range_start])} entries\")\n    for eid, fptr in ranges[range_start][:5]:  # Show first 5\n        lines.append(f\"    ID {eid:4d} (0x{eid:04X}) -&gt; 0x{fptr:08X}\")\n    if len(ranges[range_start]) &gt; 5:\n        lines.append(f\"    ... and {len(ranges[range_start])-5} more\")\n\n# Write output\noutput = \"\\n\".join(lines)\nwith open(OUTPUT_PATH, 'w') as f:\n    f.write(output)\n\nprint(f\"Output written to {OUTPUT_PATH}\")\nprint(f\"Total entries found: {len(entries)}\")\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Analyze Room 19 hotspots to find hotspot 400\"\"\"\nimport struct\n\nALFRED1 = \"/Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/files/ALFRED.1\"\n\n# Room directory at start of file\n# Each room: 13 pairs (offset, size) = 104 bytes\nROOM_ENTRY_SIZE = 104\nPAIR_SIZE = 8\nNUM_PAIRS = 13\n\ndef read_u16(data, offset):\n    return struct.unpack_from(\"&lt;H\", data, offset)[0]\n\ndef read_u32(data, offset):\n    return struct.unpack_from(\"&lt;I\", data, offset)[0]\n\ndef get_room_pair(data, room_num, pair_num):\n    room_offset = room_num * ROOM_ENTRY_SIZE\n    pair_offset = room_offset + pair_num * PAIR_SIZE\n    offset = read_u32(data, pair_offset)\n    size = read_u32(data, pair_offset + 4)\n    return offset, size\n\ndef analyze_room_hotspots(data, room_num):\n    print(f\"\\n=== Room {room_num} Analysis ===\")\n    \n    # Get pair 10 (room data)\n    offset, size = get_room_pair(data, room_num, 10)\n    print(f\"Pair 10 offset: 0x{offset:X}, size: {size}\")\n    \n    if size == 0:\n        print(\"  Room has no data (empty)\")\n        return\n    \n    room_data = data[offset:offset+size]\n    \n    # Sprite count at offset 0x05\n    sprite_count = room_data[0x05]\n    print(f\"Sprite count: {sprite_count}\")\n    \n    # Analyze sprites (start after header, 44 bytes each)\n    print(\"\\n--- Sprites (potential hotspots) ---\")\n    for i in range(sprite_count):\n        sprite_offset = 6 + i * 0x2C\n        if sprite_offset + 0x2C &gt; len(room_data):\n            print(f\"  Sprite {i}: data truncated\")\n            continue\n        \n        x = read_u16(room_data, sprite_offset + 0x00)\n        y = read_u16(room_data, sprite_offset + 0x02)\n        width = room_data[sprite_offset + 0x04]\n        height = room_data[sprite_offset + 0x05]\n        sprite_type = room_data[sprite_offset + 0x21]  # byte +33\n        action_flags = room_data[sprite_offset + 0x22]  # byte +34\n        is_hotspot = room_data[sprite_offset + 0x26]  # byte +38\n        \n        # Check if sprite has an \"extra\" field for ID\n        # Let's check byte +6 and nearby bytes\n        extra_byte6 = room_data[sprite_offset + 0x06]\n        extra_word_at_6 = read_u16(room_data, sprite_offset + 0x06) if sprite_offset + 8 &lt;= len(room_data) else 0\n        \n        is_click = \"CLICKABLE\" if (sprite_type != 0xFF and is_hotspot == 0 and action_flags != 0) else \"not clickable\"\n        \n        print(f\"  Sprite {i+1}: pos=({x},{y}) size={width}x{height} type={sprite_type} actions=0x{action_flags:02X} isHot={is_hotspot} extra6=0x{extra_byte6:02X}({extra_byte6}) [{is_click}]\")\n    \n    # Static hotspots at offset 0x47C\n    hotspot_count_offset = 0x47A\n    hotspot_data_offset = 0x47C\n    \n    if hotspot_count_offset &lt; len(room_data):\n        hotspot_count = room_data[hotspot_count_offset]\n        print(f\"\\n--- Static Hotspots (count={hotspot_count} at offset 0x{hotspot_count_offset:X}) ---\")\n        \n        for i in range(hotspot_count):\n            hs_offset = hotspot_data_offset + i * 9\n            if hs_offset + 9 &gt; len(room_data):\n                print(f\"  Hotspot {i}: data truncated\")\n                continue\n            \n            hs_type = room_data[hs_offset + 0]\n            hs_x = read_u16(room_data, hs_offset + 1)\n            hs_y = read_u16(room_data, hs_offset + 3)\n            hs_w = room_data[hs_offset + 5]\n            hs_h = room_data[hs_offset + 6]\n            hs_extra = read_u16(room_data, hs_offset + 7)\n            \n            print(f\"  Hotspot {i}: type=0x{hs_type:02X} pos=({hs_x},{hs_y}) size={hs_w}x{hs_h} EXTRA={hs_extra} (0x{hs_extra:04X})\")\n            \n            if hs_extra == 400:\n                print(f\"    *** FOUND HOTSPOT 400! ***\")\n                print(f\"    Raw bytes: {room_data[hs_offset:hs_offset+9].hex()}\")\n    else:\n        print(f\"\\nStatic hotspot area not present (room_data too short)\")\n    \n    # Check exits\n    exit_count_offset = 0x1BE\n    exit_data_offset = 0x1BF\n    \n    if exit_count_offset &lt; len(room_data):\n        exit_count = room_data[exit_count_offset]\n        print(f\"\\n--- Exits (count={exit_count}) ---\")\n        \n        for i in range(exit_count):\n            ex_offset = exit_data_offset + i * 14\n            if ex_offset + 14 &gt; len(room_data):\n                print(f\"  Exit {i}: data truncated\")\n                continue\n            \n            dest_room = read_u16(room_data, ex_offset + 0)\n            flags = room_data[ex_offset + 2]\n            trig_x = read_u16(room_data, ex_offset + 3)\n            trig_y = read_u16(room_data, ex_offset + 5)\n            trig_w = room_data[ex_offset + 7]\n            trig_h = room_data[ex_offset + 8]\n            dest_x = read_u16(room_data, ex_offset + 9)\n            dest_y = read_u16(room_data, ex_offset + 11)\n            dest_dir = room_data[ex_offset + 13]\n            \n            print(f\"  Exit {i}: dest_room={dest_room} flags=0x{flags:02X} trigger=({trig_x},{trig_y},{trig_w}x{trig_h}) dest=({dest_x},{dest_y}) dir={dest_dir}\")\n\ndef search_all_rooms_for_extra_400(data):\n    print(\"\\n\\n\" + \"=\"*60)\n    print(\"SEARCHING ALL ROOMS FOR HOTSPOT EXTRA=400\")\n    print(\"=\"*60)\n    \n    for room in range(56):\n        offset, size = get_room_pair(data, room, 10)\n        if size == 0:\n            continue\n        \n        room_data = data[offset:offset+size]\n        \n        # Check static hotspots\n        if 0x47C &lt; len(room_data):\n            hotspot_count = room_data[0x47A] if 0x47A &lt; len(room_data) else 0\n            for i in range(hotspot_count):\n                hs_offset = 0x47C + i * 9\n                if hs_offset + 9 &lt;= len(room_data):\n                    hs_extra = read_u16(room_data, hs_offset + 7)\n                    if hs_extra == 400:\n                        print(f\"Room {room}: Static hotspot {i} has EXTRA=400!\")\n                        hs_type = room_data[hs_offset + 0]\n                        hs_x = read_u16(room_data, hs_offset + 1)\n                        hs_y = read_u16(room_data, hs_offset + 3)\n                        hs_w = room_data[hs_offset + 5]\n                        hs_h = room_data[hs_offset + 6]\n                        print(f\"  type=0x{hs_type:02X} pos=({hs_x},{hs_y}) size={hs_w}x{hs_h}\")\n                        print(f\"  Raw bytes: {room_data[hs_offset:hs_offset+9].hex()}\")\n        \n        # Check sprites\n        sprite_count = room_data[0x05] if len(room_data) &gt; 0x05 else 0\n        for i in range(sprite_count):\n            sprite_offset = 6 + i * 0x2C\n            if sprite_offset + 0x2C &lt;= len(room_data):\n                # Check various fields that might be ID 400\n                extra_at_6 = read_u16(room_data, sprite_offset + 6)\n                if extra_at_6 == 400:\n                    print(f\"Room {room}: Sprite {i+1} has word at +0x06 = 400!\")\n\ndef main():\n    with open(ALFRED1, \"rb\") as f:\n        data = f.read()\n    \n    print(f\"Loaded ALFRED.1: {len(data)} bytes\")\n    \n    # Analyze room 19 in detail\n    analyze_room_hotspots(data, 19)\n    \n    # Also check nearby rooms\n    for r in [18, 20]:\n        analyze_room_hotspots(data, r)\n    \n    # Search all rooms\n    search_all_rooms_for_extra_400(data)\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}
